title: Disembodiment
body:
Tiny snack of a mod that adds two items: the Dematerializer and Inkor.

Dematerializer: A pricey block that dematerializes players upon activation, allowing for spectator-style noclip.

Inkor: The fuel that activates the Dematerializer's effect. Default time dematerialized is 15 seconds per Inkor.

*   Multiple Inkors can be put in the Dematerializer to lengthen the time spent observing
*   Also adds some little structures in the overworld
*   Clientside config for disabling SFX and visuals
*   Server config for changing gameplay values relating to the Dematerializer and Inkor
*   Both server and client need the mod

Here's a quick video demonstration of all the jargon I just said!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-fYOqyO1P44

Enjoy!
